a.lede: On Equity, we discussed the Trump administration's attempts to rebrand AI.
a.title: Can ‘super intelligence’ and a non-binding safety pact solve AI’s image problem?

b.title: It’s not AI anymore, it’s ‘super intelligence’ (according to the White House)
